title: Furukawa Electric Power Systems shipment system breach: date corrected to the company's own notice
what_changed: The event was dated 17 November 2026, the day Security NEXT reported it. Furukawa Electric Power Systems' own notice (feps.co.jp/news/20261026/) and Furukawa Electric's group notice are dated 26 October 2026, so the date is now 26 October and the company's notices are cited first. The summary now gives the announcement date and the company's phishing warning; the facts of the incident are unchanged.
